subject: Armored searobin
topic: This fish looks like it's wearing a suit of armor, and it walks on its fins.
script:
This fish looks like it's wearing a suit of armor, and it walks on its fins.
It's an armored searobin.
Its body is covered with four rows of bony plates, each with a short, curved spine.
It has horn-like points on its snout, and branched whiskers under its mouth.
Those whiskers help it feel for food in the sand and mud.
Instead of swimming everywhere, it uses special fins to stroll along the seafloor.
It's a deep-sea cousin of the searobins that live in shallow water along US coasts.
This one was filmed six hundred meters down, in the Straits of Florida.
Knight in armor, or deep-sea robot?
